thread:
sam: kicking off staged traffic shift to green in eu-west, starting with 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% windows. plan: drain old pool, warm new pool for 5m before each bump. observers: @alex @mei.chen @rajiv. change window: 2026-03-20T14:00Z - 14:30Z.

deploy-bot: [INFO] start deploy v2026.03.20-green. Artifacts: router-config v2.8, model-serving v1.14.6. Canary target: service-edge-euwest-1a.

alex: copy — I'll watch latency and 99th tail, have a runbook open. if p50 increases >50ms or p99 > 500ms we abort and pin to v1.14.5.

mei.chen: verified instance pool warmup script works on staging. warmup logs: `warmup: 32/32 warm connections, kv-cache primed`. ready to promote. :thumbsup:

rajiv: router change ready. I'll apply weighted policy in 3 wave steps. gating: after each bump wait 3m observation. rollback criteria: error rate >1% or request timeout >0.5%.

router-bot: applying weight 5% -> green. weights: green=5%, blue=95%.

sam: 0m after first bump — looks normal. no errors spike.

alex: seeing slight increase in decode latency for long contexts (+30ms) but within threshold. continuing.

router-bot: bumping to 20%. weights: green=20%, blue=80%.

mei.chen: warmup hold looks fine, kv-hit ratio steady. metrics dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/edge/green-canary :eyes:

rajiv: monitoring logging for 502/504. nothing anomalous so far.

sam: after 20% hold for 3m — approve 50% move.

router-bot: bumping to 50%. weights: green=50%, blue=50%.

deploy-bot: note: pinned traffic policy applied: fallback to blue on 5xx if green error rate >0.8% for 2 consecutive minutes.

alex: p99 spike short-lived at +220ms for 90s, then back. not hitting abort thresholds.

mei.chen: sanity check logs, found 2 small schema warnings from telemetry agent, not user-impacting.

rajiv: if we hit rollback, plan is immediate drain green and ramp blue to 100%, then create incident. have rollback script ready: `scripts/rollback-router.sh --target blue --drain-wait 60`.

sam: proceeding to 100% now.

router-bot: final weights: green=100%, blue=0%. commit router-config v2.8 -> active.

deploy-bot: deploy complete. release notes: "v2026.03.20: model-serving v1.14.6, router-config v2.8, improved kv-cache priming".

alex: running post-deploy checks: latency p50/p95/p99 within SLOs, error rate 0.12%. marking healthy.

mei.chen: adding note to release docs: warmup increased to 5m between shifts after this test.

sam: thanks team. I'll close the change window at 14:26Z. if anyone sees anything odd ping #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:

rajiv: logged final state and pinned version in config DB: router.v=2.8, service=v1.14.6.

alex: two small followups: (1) add a short smoke test after each bump next time; (2) capture the short p99 blip for investigation.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] created follow-up ticket INF-4821 "investigate p99 blip during staged drain" assigned to mei.chen.

mei.chen: acknowledged, will take it.

sam: thread closed — great job.
